basic_details.job_title: AIIMS New Delhi Project Research Scientist II (Forensic Medicine) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Forensic Medicine, AIIMS, New Delhi has one contractual post of Project Research Scientist II (Non-Medical) under the NIMH, USA-funded research project "Building Resources for the Diversification of Genetic Data on Suicide Death" (Project Code: N2459). The post runs up to 28 February 2029 and pays as per ICMR project salary norms. Candidates need a first class Master's degree in a relevant subject with three years' experience, or a PhD. They must be within the age limit of 40 years. Applications and CVs go by email to [email protected] by 26 November 2026.

age_limit.details: The age limit is 40 years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age. It also does not mention any age relaxation. | See the official notification for the exact eligibility wording for this post.

The notice lists these subjects: | Forensic Science Life Science Genetics, Human Genetics or Molecular Genetics Biotechnology or Bioinformatics Neuroscience or Neurobiology Molecular Medicine or Biomedical Science

how_to_apply: Send your application and CV by email to [email protected] on or before 26 November 2026. The notice does not prescribe an application form, an email subject line or a list of documents beyond these.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS New Delhi Project Research Scientist II (non-medical)
content_sections.text: This post sits in the Department of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology at AIIMS, New Delhi. The notice is issued by Dr Chittaranjan Behera, Professor and Principal Investigator. The post serves a research project titled "Building Resources for the Diversification of Genetic Data on Suicide Death", funded by the National Institute of Mental Health (NIMH), USA.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: A first class Master's degree in a relevant subject or field, with three years' experience, or a PhD. The notice lists these subjects: Forensic Science Life Science Genetics, Human Genetics or Molecular Genetics Biotechnology or Bioinformatics Neuroscience or Neurobiology Molecular Medicine or Biomedical Science Experience of working in a molecular biology laboratory. The age limit is 40 years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age. It also does not mention any age relaxation. See the official notification for the exact eligibility wording for this post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The salary for the post will be as per ICMR project salary norms. The notice does not print an amount and does not mention HRA or other allowances. The position is contractual under the NIMH, USA-funded project, with tenure up to 28 February 2029.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS New Delhi Project Research Scientist II (non-medical)
content_sections.text: Send your application and CV by email to [email protected] on or before 26 November 2026. The notice does not prescribe an application form, an email subject line or a list of documents beyond these. Application CV The notice gives this office address for the Principal Investigator: Room No. 303, Department of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology, AIIMS, Ansari Nagar, New Delhi-110029.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications will be screened, and only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. The notice does not give the interview date, venue or mode.
